description: Create a Google Shopping campaign in the connected Google Ads account — step 2 of 2, after preview_google_shopping_campaign. A REAL write to the live ad account, but the campaign is always created PAUSED: this tool never activates or starts one, and spends nothing until a person starts it in Google Ads. It obeys the owner's own settings on the Ads page: refused unless campaign creation is armed there and the daily budget is within the owner's cap. It is also refused until the workspace owner switches on 'AI may create paused ad campaigns' (Settings → Integrations → Connect AI), and an API token is refused because it has no role — only a signed-in owner or administrator can create. Returns { campaignResourceName, status: 'PAUSED' }. Not idempotent: Google refuses a duplicate name. Never tell the user a campaign is running. Use list_ad_campaigns afterwards, once the sync has read it. The result echoes the workspace.

dailyBudget.description: Daily budget as a positive decimal string in the ad account's currency, for example '15.00'. Send only an amount the person stated. Refused if it is above the owner's cap.

labelIndex.description: Optional: which custom label slot (0 to 4) limits the campaign to a group of products. Needs labelValue.

labelValue.description: Optional: the value of that custom label, for example 'margin_high'. Needs labelIndex.

maxCpc.description: Maximum cost per click as a positive decimal string in the ad account's currency, for example '0.40'.

name.description: Campaign name, at most 128 characters. Google refuses a name already in use.

name: create_google_shopping_campaign
title: Create Google Shopping campaign
